recentItems.title: Russia war latest: Ukrainians are 'exhausted'
recentItems.description:
“Ukrainians are tired of being resilient. They are exhausted.”

Kateryna Bondar, a senior fellow with the Wadhwani AI Center at the Center for Strategic and International Studies, explains how Russia’s relentless drone attacks and air raid sirens are disrupting everyday life in Ukraine, from public transport to business operations.

[Subscribe to our Substack newsletter: https://channel4news.substack.com/subscribe]

As attacks continue around the clock, civilians face growing challenges in maintaining a normal life.

For more, watch the latest FourSight on YouTube.

recentItems.title: Scottish activist granted bail after nine years of jail in India
recentItems.description:
A Scottish man has been granted bail, nine years after he was detained in India.

[Subscribe to our Substack newsletter: https://channel4news.substack.com/subscribe]

Sikh activist Jagtar Singh Johal was arrested in 2017 in connection with alleged terror offences, but has never been convicted.

Scotland's First Minister John Swinney welcomed the news, adding that he hoped Jagtar and his family would be reunited soon, though his legal team warned he is still not a free man.

recentItems.description:

[Subscribe to our Substack newsletter: https://channel4news.substack.com/subscribe]

recentItems.title: French president warns hybrid war against Europe intensifying
recentItems.description:
The Foreign Office has accused Russia of trying to "deflect attention" from its war in Ukraine after Moscow warned it reserved the right to take "retaliatory measures" over the UK's military support. 

[Subscribe to our Substack newsletter: https://channel4news.substack.com/subscribe]

At the same time - the French president Emmanuel Macron said that a hybrid war against Europe was already intensifying. And Russia has continued its strikes across Ukraine throughout the day - including Kyiv which came under ballistic missile attack this evening.

recentItems.title: "America has changed": Inside Canada’s plan with Britain to build a new economic bloc
recentItems.description:

[Subscribe to our Substack newsletter: https://channel4news.substack.com/subscribe]

Krishnan Guru-Murthy interviews the Canadian finance minister, François-Philippe Champagne, after top level talks in Downing Street about pivoting away from US dependency, securing critical minerals, and why Western allies must accept that the old transatlantic order is gone for good.

recentItems.title: Transgender officers served Trump until they were forced out
recentItems.description:
When President Trump was sworn in, he said official US government policy would only recognise two genders: male and female.

[Subscribe to our Substack newsletter: https://channel4news.substack.com/subscribe]

His administration's anti-trans agenda has seen government agencies purged, including pushing senior officials out of the White House and the military.

We spoke to Julia Curlee, former senior CIA officer (2007-26), now working as a Public Service Fellow at Lawfare, and Colonel Bree Fram who served in the United States Air Force (2003-21) and United States Space Force (2021-2025).

Watch the full interview here: https://youtu.be/Y0WZN2C1vQ0

recentItems.title: Fired trans officers warn of chaos under Trump
recentItems.description:
When Donald Trump returned to the White House, Julia Curlee and Colonel Bree Fram were two of the most senior transgender officials in US national security. 

After 20 years in the CIA and 23 years across the Air Force and Space Force, they were forced out.

In this in-depth interview, they describe the chaos inside the National Security Council and how the American security system has been dismantled under Trump.

[Subscribe to our Substack newsletter: https://channel4news.substack.com/subscribe]

US Editor Anushka Asthana sits down with Julia Curlee, former senior CIA officer (2007-26) who is now working as a Public Service Fellow at Lawfare and Colonel Bree Fram who served in the United States Air Force (2003-21) and United States Space Force (2021-2025).

Producers: Mahnoor Akhlaq, Matthew Cundall, Gracie Jerome & Isobel Rowland
Camera: Ben Martin
Editor: Eammon Ashton-Atkinson
